description: Get the full structured data for one ImotAI listing by its id or slug: price, price per m², area, rooms, floor, construction, heating, location (city/district), features, and an authoritative per-listing marketContext (district average and median price per m², deviation percent, comparable active count). Does NOT return the broker free-text description, contact details, or exact coordinates.

id.description: The listing id (UUID) or its URL slug.

name: get_property
title: Get one ImotAI listing
